Not all spells are accessible for every mage. Spells outside of the 'General' spell school requires a mage to specialize in that spell school to be able to understand and cast those kind of spells.

Start by throwing [Q] a rift charge into an arclight furnace to start essence infusion. When you have the resulting essence core, Right mouse click it to mark the spell school on the core. Various cores will have different spell schools they can become. When a spell school is selected, [Sneak] + Right mouse click to start the conversion to an attunement core. After that, [Sneak] + Right mouse click again to soulbind to it. Once soulbound, equip it and the attunement process is done.

Mages can only be attuned to 1 spell school at a time. All mages have access to the 'General' spells regardless of attunement. When removing an attunement core there will be an exhaustion debuff that prevents attunement for a period of time.

This attunement core takes it a step further enhancing the attributes for that specific spell school.

Start by throwing [Q] an attunement core into an arclight furnace to start essence infusion. Each core type will need specific essence:
- Evocation core = neutral essence
- Alteration core = light essence
- Incantation core = dark essence
- Conjuration core = light or dark essence

When you have the resulting advanced attunement core, [Sneak] + Right mouse click to soulbind to it. Once soulbound, equip it and the attunement process is done.

Mages can only be attuned to 1 spell school at a time. All mages have access to the 'General' spells regardless of attunement. When removing any attunement cores there will be an exhaustion debuff that prevents attunement for a period of time.

These are blocks that mages can create to serve a specific purpose. Anyone can use these blocks, including non-magic users.

Utility blocks must be placed near a runestone to function. The potency depends on the runestone they are attached to.

• Arcanus runestone: 6 block radius
• Etherium runestone: 12 block radius
• Chimerite runestone: 18 block radius
This block can be recharged with the spell 'Transmutation' or by applying rusty dust directly to the block with Shift + Right mouse click. The charge amount depends on the block itself.

This block can create new magical objects by channeling different types of essence from linked essence generators.

To get started, link this block to any essence generator. Can only link one at a time. You will see magical flames appear. After that, just throw [Q] in any item tagged for essence infusion and wait until it is finished. Infusion will only start if the required essence is present on the essence generator. Use Right mouse click to retrieve created objects. You can get additional information by using [Sneak] and looking at this block.

Each item created with essence infusion has a chance to create an extra primordial fragment.

When a mage dies in the world, grimoires linked to the mage through a sanctum will lose durability. Durability can also be lost when using the magitrix. If durability reaches 0, the grimoire will disintegrate. To repair a grimoire, throw it into an arclight furnace with the same essence as the grimoire. Essence amount depends on the grimoire's tier.

Essence is an invisible force that exists everywhere in the world. This force comes in neutral, light, and dark types. Using a resonator, a mage can make leyline connections from 'essence generators' to various 'magic stations' to supply them with essence.
These are essential blocks that are linked to various magic systems. Each magic station serves a specific purpose and are the foundations for magic progression.

When an Animus is bound to an animus vessel, it takes the form of a Servitor by default. This is a basic companion with limited skills. A calling item can be thrown along side an animus vessel at the time of summoning to shape the Animus, creating a specialized companion with abilities and traits for a specific class.

Start with making a training weapon for the calling path you want your Animus to work towards and equip it on your Animus. This training weapon grants your Servitor a temporary skill for the class it is working towards. Each time it uses that skill, it will gain experience. When this experience is full, use the training weapon as a catalyst in the 'Ritual of Binding' to create a calling item. This will cost the mage 300 mana to complete the ritual.

Only a Servitor can use training weapons. All experience is stored on the training weapon itself. Animus death doesn't effect experience gained. Using the 'Unbind Animus Vessel' spell will drop the animus vessel and calling item. If the Animus fractures, the vessel and calling is lost.
